name: How much does garage painting and trim work cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does garage painting and trim work cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing usually depends on square footage, surface condition, and the materials used. Some Denver-area garage painting estimates run about $2.00 to $4.50 per square foot for walls and ceilings, while coatings like epoxy are priced separately and start higher.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on size, condition, and materials. Wall and ceiling painting is often priced by square foot, while floor coatings are usually an extra line item.
